H1_msb_displacement.mechanism: A decisive structure break with a large-body candle signals informed order flow; continuation follows.

H2_sweep_reversal.mechanism: Stops cluster beyond obvious highs/lows; a sweep that closes back inside and breaks the sweep bar shows exhaustion.

H3_opening_range.mechanism: Session opens concentrate institutional order flow; early direction persists through the session.

H4_trend_day.mechanism: Days that move far early are often driven by persistent flows that continue into the close.

H5_compression_expansion.mechanism: Volatility clusters; a breakout from an unusually tight range starts a high-volatility leg.

H6_session_gold.mechanism: 6a: New York often reverses an extended London move in gold. 6b: Asian session is range-bound; stretches revert.

H7_news_momentum.mechanism: Scheduled US data shocks are absorbed over more than one bar; after the first bar the move continues.

H8_failed_breakout.mechanism: Breakout traders who entered on a close beyond a level are trapped when price closes back inside; their exits fuel the reversal.
